title: Vita et passio S. Thomae Cantuariensis

fontes.raw: Vide Vitam S. Thomae auctore Edwardo Grim, col. 1 usque ad Pie igitur etc. col., 2.

heads.la: INCIPIT PROLOGUS IN VITAM, PASSIONEM ET PROCESSUM SANCTI THOMAE CANTUARIENSIS ARCHIEPISCOPI ET MARTYRIS SUPER ECCLESIASTICA LIBERTATE.
heads.en: HERE BEGINS THE PROLOGUE TO THE LIFE, PASSION, AND PROCEEDINGS OF SAINT THOMAS, ARCHBISHOP OF CANTERBURY AND MARTYR, CONCERNING THE LIBERTY OF THE CHURCH.

heads.la: CAPITULUM PRIMUM. DE VITA ET MORIBUS PARENTUM SANCTI THOMAE.
heads.en: CHAPTER ONE. ON THE LIFE AND CHARACTER OF THE PARENTS OF SAINT THOMAS.

heads.la: CAPITULUM II. DE ORTU MIRABILI BEATI THOMAE.
heads.en: CHAPTER II. ON THE MARVELOUS BIRTH OF BLESSED THOMAS.

heads.la: CAPITULUM III. DE VISIONIBUS MATRIS EJUS PER QUAS FUTURAM CREDIMUS SANCTAE SOBOLIS EXCELLENTIAM PRAEFIGURARI.
heads.en: CHAPTER III. ON THE VISIONS OF HIS MOTHER, BY WHICH WE BELIEVE THE COMING EXCELLENCE OF HER HOLY OFFSPRING WAS PREFIGURED.

heads.la: CAPITULUM IV. QUALITER SE HABUERIT IN JUVENTUTE.
heads.en: CHAPTER IV. HOW HE CONDUCTED HIMSELF IN HIS YOUTH.

headnotes.la: …emia futurorum. Qui cum responderet quod Anglicus esset et Londoniarum civitatis incola, atque inquisita de fide Christi prout melius noverat exposuisset, consequenter et ipsa ab eo scistitavit dicens
headnotes.en: …d when he answered that he was an Englishman and a dweller in the city of London, and had set forth what she asked about the faith of Christ as best he knew, she thereupon *scistitavit* of him, saying

headnotes.la: …er exstitit praeparatum in quo debuerat baptizari, Cumque interrogaretur in medio posita, prout mos exigit Ecclesiae, per saepedictum Ricardum communem eorum interpretem si vellet baptizari, respondit
headnotes.en: …aptized, And when, set in the midst, she was asked — as the custom of the Church requires — through the oft-mentioned Richard, their common interpreter, whether she wished to be baptized, she answered

headnotes.la: …um voto viri sui annuit, imo rogavit et hortabatur ut quid concepisset in mente quo complacere suo crederet Creatori, nulla de se habita consideratione tam prompte exsequeretur quam devote, et adjecit
headnotes.en: …en asked and exhorted him that whatever he had conceived in mind, by which he believed he might please his Creator, he should carry out as promptly as devoutly, taking no account of her. And she added

headnotes.la: … est domina quaedam statura procera, vultu placido et aspectu decora, in lecto decumbenti astitisse, et puero de sanitate pollicita confortato, duas claves aureas tradidisse sibi in manu in haec verba
headnotes.en: …as he lay in bed — tall of stature, calm of face and comely of aspect — and, when the boy had been comforted by her promise of health, to have handed him two golden keys into his hand with these words

headnotes.la: …mo Mertoniae eum priori Roberto aliquandiu nutriendum tradiderat, venit quadam die pater filium visurus: introductoque puero coram priore pater procidens pronus adoravit. Indignans vero prior ait illi
headnotes.en: …t up for a while, the father came one day to see his son; and when the boy had been brought in before the prior, the father fell forward and did reverence to him. But the prior, indignant, said to him
To whom the father said in private

proseNotes.raw: ( Post haec quadrilogus iste prior fere ad verbum concordat cum secundo quadrilogo, de quo posthac dicturi sumus. At pro tribus quinque libros complectitur; quorum quartus De Gestis post martyrium est; quintus epistolas quasdam circiter 70 continet. Quod dixisse sufficiat de hac compilatione. Liber ipse, quo continentur haec, jam rarus factus, satis magni pretii aestimatur et venditur. Est in bibliotheca Sancti Audomari liber ms. de Vita S. Thomae, qui idem fere est cum primo quadrilogo edito, et praeter ea paucula de obsidione Tolosae ex opere Willelmi filii Stephani excerpta habet. )
